# Roughtime test-vector provenance

`roughtime_ietf_draft08_001.json` is an unchanged Apache-2.0 test vector
by the Cloudflare Roughtime authors and contributors. Its upstream GitHub
blob is `2eee9e2f2c7003bb90612d0f630d20c1b7645e2b`.

The JSON's `root_key` contains a test seed. The host test derives its
public key and uses it only to verify the offline fixture.
[Upstream vector](https://github.com/cloudflare/roughtime/blob/master/protocol/testdata/roughtime_ietf_draft08_001.json)
